--- Comment #6 from Benjamin Tyner (<mailto:btyner@gmail.com|btyner@gmail.com>) ---
This line in the patch 

```
if (is.finite(resvar) && resvar < (mean(fitted)^2 + var(c(fitted))) * 1e-30) {
   perfect.fit[y] <- TRUE
}
```
appears to blend a squared measure of location with a variance measure, which
could be overly sensitive to the scale of the data and/or shifting the data by
a constant. Perhaps something like the following (untested!) would be more
robust?
```
y.var <- var(c(fitted)) + resvar # total variance of the response
if (is.finite(resvar) && resvar < y.var * .Machine$double.eps^2) {
   perfect.fit[y] <- TRUE
}
```
